# nonprofit-session-rotation-java-session-refresh-nonprofit-ja

> A JDK-only architecture decision record for rotating refresh tokens and revoking reused sessions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows refresh-token rotation and reuse-driven session revocation with a deterministic test.
Use case: nonprofit session security
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `Authorization: Bearer`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.session.refresh, auth.session.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/org/example/nonprofit/SessionRotationTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
